trans_rules:
(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.attribute" "." (str ".") ".") "*")
  (fragment ("js.member_expression" ".1" (str ".") ".2") "*3")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.expression_statement" ("py.assignment" ("py.identifier" (val "Clz")) (str "=") ("py.call" ("py.identifier" (val "type")) ("py.argument_list" (str "(") ("py.string" (str "\"") ("py.string_content" (val "BinarySearchTree")) (str "\"")) (str ",") ("py.tuple" (str "(") (str ")")) (str ",") ("py.dictionary" (str "{") (str "}")) (str ")"))))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.variable_declaration" (str "var") ("js.variable_declarator" ("js.identifier" (val "Clz")) (str "=") ("js.class" (str "class") ("js.identifier" (val "BinarySearchTree")) ("js.class_body" (str "{") (str "}")))) (str ";")) "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.expression_statement" ("py.assignment" ("py.identifier" (val "Clz")) (str "=") ("py.call" ("py.identifier" (val "type")) ("py.argument_list" (str "(") ("py.string" (str "\"") ("py.string_content" (val "BinarySearchTree")) (str "\"")) (str ",") ("py.tuple" (str "(") (str ")")) (str ",") ("py.dictionary" (str "{") (str "}")) (str ")"))))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.expression_statement" ("js.assignment_expression" ("js.identifier" (val "Clz")) (str "=") ("js.class" (str "class") ("js.identifier" (val "BinarySearchTree")) ("js.class_body" (str "{") (str "}")))) (str ";")) "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.expression_statement" ("py.assignment" "." (str "=") ".")) "*")
  (fragment ("js.variable_declaration" (str "var") ("js.variable_declarator" ".1" (str "=") ".2") (str ";")) "*3")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.expression_statement" ("py.assignment" "." (str "=") ".")) "*")
  (fragment ("js.expression_statement" ("js.assignment_expression" ".1" (str "=") ".2") (str ";")) "*3")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.call" "." ("py.argument_list" (str "(") (str ")"))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.call_expression" ".1" ("js.arguments" (str "(") (str ")"))) "*2")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.call" "." ("py.argument_list" (str "(") (str ")"))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.new_expression" (str "new") ".1" ("js.arguments" (str "(") (str ")"))) "*2")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.expression_statement" ("py.call" "." ("py.argument_list" (str "(") (str ")")))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.expression_statement" ("js.call_expression" ".1" ("js.arguments" (str "(") (str ")"))) (str ";")) "*2")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.expression_statement" ("py.call" "." ("py.argument_list" (str "(") (str ")")))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.expression_statement" ("js.new_expression" (str "new") ".1" ("js.arguments" (str "(") (str ")"))) (str ";")) "*2")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.module" "*"))
  (fragment ("js.program" "*1"))
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.function_definition" (str "def") "*") "*")
  (fragment ("js.function_declaration" (str "function") "*1") "*2")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.identifier" "_val_") "*")
  (fragment ("js.identifier" "_val1_") "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.parameters" "*") "*")
  (fragment ("js.formal_parameters" "*1") "*2")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.default_parameter" "." (str "=") ".") "*")
  (fragment ("js.assignment_pattern" ".1" (str "=") ".2") "*3")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.block" "*") "*")
  (fragment ("js.statement_block" "*1") "*2")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.pass_statement" "*") "*")
  (fragment "*2")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.integer" "_val_") "*")
  (fragment ("js.number" "_val1_") "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.float" "_val_") "*")
  (fragment ("js.number" "_val1_") "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.string_content" "_val_") "*")
  (fragment ("js.string_fragment" "_val1_") "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.string" "*") "*")
  (fragment ("js.string" "*1") "*2")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.identifier" "_val_") "*")
  (fragment ("js.property_identifier" "_val1_") "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.comment" "_val_") "*")
  (fragment "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.import_from_statement" (str "from") ("py.dotted_name" ("py.identifier" "_val_")) (str "import") ("py.wildcard_import" (str "*"))) "*")
  (fragment "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.import_from_statement" (str "from") ("py.dotted_name" ("py.identifier" "_val_")) (str "import") ("py.dotted_name" ("py.identifier" "_val_"))) "*")
  (fragment "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.import_statement" (str "import") ("py.dotted_name" ("py.identifier" "_val_"))) "*")
  (fragment "*1")
)

(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.attribute" ("py.identifier" (val "sys")) (str ".") ("py.identifier" (val "maxsize"))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.number" (val "9223372036854776000")) "*1")
)

;;;; myexactlog with any number of arguments
(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.expression_statement" ("py.call" ("py.identifier" (val "myexactlog")) ("py.argument_list" (str "(") "*" ))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.expression_statement" ("js.call_expression" ("js.identifier" (val "myexactlog")) ("js.arguments" (str "(") "*1" ))) "*2")
)

;;;;;;;; these rules are needed to obtain the translation of the test script in source language

;;;;;;;; translates `secret_fun_4071()` function call that is inserted as a statement in `block`
(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.expression_statement" ("py.call" ("py.identifier" (val "secret_fun_4071")) ("py.argument_list" (str "(") (str ")")))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.expression_statement" ("js.call_expression" ("js.identifier" (val "secret_fun_4071")) ("js.arguments" (str "(") (str ")")))) "*1")
)

;;;;;;;; translates `secret_fun_4071()` function call that is inserted as a `call` in body node types (e.g. `list`)
(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.call" ("py.identifier" (val "secret_fun_4071")) ("py.argument_list" (str "(") (str ")"))) "*")
  (fragment ("js.call_expression" ("js.identifier" (val "secret_fun_4071")) ("js.arguments" (str "(") (str ")"))) "*1")
)

;;;;;;;; inserted into loops so that they terminate
(match_expand
  (fragment ("py.break_statement") "*")
  (fragment ("js.break_statement") "*1")
)
